title: The seawall, two
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Wednesday evening. The seawall. Wood and the dog, as every evening. Chloe already on it, ten feet down, reading. The dog goes to her. Wood follows the dog, which is his excuse. They sit ten feet apart and then the dog closes it.

panels.composition: The seawall at evening. CHLOE on it, reading. WOOD and BARNABY arriving. Ten feet of wall between.

image.prompt: a young woman reading on a low seawall at evening as a young man and a small dog arrive ten feet away, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The dog going straight to her. Her hand on him without looking up from the book.

image.prompt: a small dog trotting to a young woman on a seawall who rests her hand on it without looking up from her book, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood sitting. Ten feet. The book. The bay. The dog between, then not between — beside her.

image.prompt: a young man sitting on a seawall ten feet from a reading young woman, a small dog settled against her side, black and white, no words

balloons.text: You didn't come to the bus.
